text:
From: Elena Varga, Data Protection Lead, Brindle Harbour Authority
To: (vendor support address)
Date: 14 April 2026
Subject: Container yard drone dock - information needed for privacy assessment

Before the container yard dock can go live I need, in writing:
1. What data the dock and platform collect (video, stills, telemetry, location).
2. Where video is stored, and in which country.
3. How long each kind of data is kept, and how it is deleted.
4. Who at your company can access it, and under what controls.

I cannot sign the assessment without these. Please reply to this address.

[No reply on file.]
